The lines are in another language and won't show these words: choose them yourself from the two people's ages and relationship, as French speakers normally would. Not just "formal" or "informal". Add what changes if their relationship changes during the story. Skip this only if French has no such distinctions.
NAMES: names of people, places and things that must stay spelled the same.
Under PEOPLE, write only what the lines support, and "unknown" where they don't say. Start directly with PEOPLE, no introduction.

You're a jerk, Thom.
Look Celia, we have to follow our passions;
you have your robotics, and I just want to be awesome in space.
Why don't you just admit that you're freaked out by my robot hand?

...by these giant robotic claws of death...
